Entries.Title: Maalikaya
Entries.Description: Kara, a young inmate who unleashes her hidden sexual fantasies while serving time. After meeting Lila, a seductive inmate played by Jenn Rosa, Kara finds a new purpose in life. But her dark past still haunts her even behind bars.

Entries.Title: Ligaw
Entries.Description: A sultry woman who charms the hearts of men in a remote province. Dolores, a devoted wife to her paraplegic husband, falls for a young mountaineer. What begins as a reckless escape turns into an affair drenched in passion and secrecy.

Entries.Title: Sorority
Entries.Description: A tale of seduction and mystery. A fearless pre-law student joins an elite sorority led by a powerful heiress. As secrets unfold, she’s torn between the woman who awakened her desire and a truth that could destroy them both.

Entries.Title: Kalakal
Entries.Description: A seductive female garbage collector who embraces the life of an escort lady. Desperate to live a comfortable life, she leaves the dumpsite and enters the club. But can she also dump both her brother and her lover who remind her of her past?

Entries.Title: Rapsa
Entries.Description: All will surely want to have a taste of Micaella Raz. A beautiful lesbian manager gets attracted to her naïve employee. They eventually get entangled in a sexual relationship, blurring boundaries, leading to a shared emotional state.

Entries.Title: Sa Gabing Mainit
Entries.Description: A slew of VMX beauties are set to heat up your nights in this wildly passionate film. Nica goes to Camp Haraya, with her friends Ellen and Tony, in order to heal her broken heart. And there, she meets birthday boy Ralph and his friends. Can Ralph give Nica back her spark?

Entries.Title: Habal
Entries.Description: Danilo is a virgin motorcycle taxi driver often teased by his roommates for his lack of "experience". That is, until his passenger Erika and her best friend Lara lead him into his sexual awakening.

Entries.Title: Bulong Ng Laman
Entries.Description: From creative producer Roman Perez, Jr., comes another titillating erotic drama. VMX star Aiko Garcia plays a sexually frustrated woman who buys a vintage tocador and finds a handy partner for her sexual fantasies.

Entries.Title: One Hit Wonder
Entries.Description: When big dreams meet second chances, two dreamers Entoy and Lorina chase fame in the world of '90s OPM. Will they make it?

Entries.Title: Belyas
Entries.Description: Audrey Avila, Denise Esteban and Dani Yoshida star as sultry Belyas. A housewife who is tired of her controlling husband takes a different turn when two young prostitutes rent their apartment. As she befriends the two, she begins to admire the sexual freedom they have.

Entries.Title: L: Lakad
Entries.Description: Sexy VMX stars Vern Kaye and Paula Santos star in a story about a man, desperate to reclaim his fiancée’s engagement ring by selling their bed that is soon to be drenched in sweat and desire, for lovers hungry for sizzling and sometimes forbidden sex.

Entries.Title: Barurot
Entries.Description: Marco is a tricycle driver who is not only fast on the road, but also with women - having multiple partners at the same time. But when he meets the mysterious Lucy, will Marco finally tame his wild desires?

Entries.Title: Bangkera
Entries.Description: VMX Star Micaella Raz takes on an edgy role as Ilyana, who defies her father’s warnings to pursue her dream of becoming a boatwoman. As she guides vlogger Levi, their journey sparks more than ambitions. How long can she control the current before something deeper takes over?

Entries.Title: Kandungan
Entries.Description: VMX sirens Rica Gonzales and Arah Alonzo sizzle in a story about a womanizing bachelor who finds his secretary's journal filled with sexual fantasies. The two turn the fantasies into reality but the appearance of his fiancée turn his world upside down.
Five lives. One city. In the heart of Manila, their stories intertwine through desire, heartbreak, and the rawness of life.

Entries.Title: Arouse
Entries.Description: Get ready to AROUSE your senses! Hosted by Aiko Garcia and Jenn Rosa, this steamy special brings you the hottest, most unforgettable scenes from VMX’s A-list sirens—AJ Raval, Ayanna Misola, Azi Acosta & more. Desire, passion, and pure heat—are you ready?

Entries.Title: Kirot
Entries.Description: Details here

Entries.Title: Obsesyon
Entries.Description: A middle-aged woman becomes obsessed with a student, who has a crush on her stepdaughter. Every time the young man becomes intimate with the daughter, the woman fantasizes that she is with him.

Entries.Title: The Jowa Collector
Entries.Description: Luigi, the top playboy in the university, meets Susie, a sexy, beautiful, smart student. When Luigi finally feels that he has fallen in love with Susie, he learns that Susie is his friend's girlfriend.

Entries.Title: The Illusioned Ones
Entries.Description: Emma and Sandra, bound by loss and love, find solace and passion in each other while haunted by the illusions of their past. As reality and fantasy blur, they navigate guilt, desire, and the echoes of their late spouses. How long can they live in a world of make-believe?

Entries.Title: Violet
Entries.Description: Three hottest stars Christy Imperial, Dani Yoshida and Aliya Raymundo ignite the screen in a coming-of-age story about a girl exploring her sexuality. Set against the vibrant Panagbenga festival this movie tackles love and sex in the eyes of an innocent girl.

Entries.Title: Deep Inside: Angeli Khang
Entries.Description: Hosted by Ataska, VMX fans will surely be delighted with to this treat as we dig deeper to the Queen of VMX, Angeli Khang's most iconic and steamiest scenes.

Entries.Title: Sipsipan
Entries.Description: At Sipsipan, a shady stop where truckers trade fuel for cash and pleasure, one man’s craving leads him down a path of lust, lies, and no return.

Entries.Title: Pihit
Entries.Description: A former dancer returns to pole dancing class without the permission of her conservative boyfriend. She then meets an alluring instructor who brings back the excitement in her sex life.

Entries.Title: Trianggulo
Entries.Description: Irene and Anya have it all, except a child. When a man from Anya’s past enters the picture, their plan takes a wild turn, leading to a threesome built on passion, complication, and choice.

Entries.Title: L: Langoy
Entries.Description: A steamy tale of a caretaker's forbidden love for a mysterious attic dweller. They share a passionate relationship filled with sex and life stories but one day she vanishes without a trace.

Entries.Title: Hiram na Sandali
Entries.Description: An ex-couple accidentally bumps into each other whenever they visit their dog’s grave on its death anniversary. These chance meetings will later lead to a passionate reunion of the two.

Entries.Title: Unconditional
Entries.Description: Anna, a progressive social media manager, retreats to Siargao to escape the moral conflict of helping her ex’s corrupt father win a Senate seat. There, she meets Greg, a kindhearted local caring for his ailing mother. As a new romance blossoms, Anna must confront her deepest beliefs when she discovers Greg is a trans man—challenging her notions of love, identity, and what it truly means to love without conditions.

Entries.Title: Victoria's Silver
Entries.Description: Set in 1944, Victoria, who escapes captivity as a comfort woman, finds refuge, and love, with the man Selina left in the first movie.

Entries.Title: Halimuyak
Entries.Description: Mikee finally found love after years of misery, in the form of Divine, a stunning perfumer. But when a haunting scent from Divine’s past ties to the most painful chapter of Mikee’s life, can love survive when the truth threatens to destroy everything?

Entries.Title: KungFu Boys Enter The Dragon Fist
Entries.Description: A man in davao city and came home to them in manila to protect his uncle from evil and someone destroying their business and a bad guy and they showed their kungfu skills and they succeeded.

Entries.Title: Tampipi
Entries.Description: A lonely seafarer’s wife crosses paths with a meditation and love guru. When her husband returns, she is torn between the woman who satisfies her fantasies and the man she has always loved.

Entries.Title: Hipak
Entries.Description: Roy believes he's found love and luck with three women who visited his vape shop. But as passionate romances unravel, hidden agendas force him to unleash the beast within.

Entries.Title: How To Get Away From My Toxic Family
Entries.Description: A hardworking and loyal OFW, a chef from Dubai, returns home hoping to pursue his dream of owning his restaurant and starting his own life. However, he finds himself at odds with his family and their toxic tendencies, making him question “Where does sacrifice end and selfishness begin?"

Entries.Title: WILD BOYS
Entries.Description: The film centers on an ageing macho dancer who refuses to give up his passion for dancing despite the decline of the bar he works in.

Entries.Title: Paquil
Entries.Description: "Paquil" tells the story of Christina, a once-celebrated actress who, after experiencing several career flops and being diagnosed with a life-threatening illness, returns to her hometown of Pakil. This town holds deep childhood memories for her and is known for the long-lost tradition of Komedya, a local theatrical performance. Now at a crossroads in her life, Christina becomes determined to revive this cultural art form as she grapples with her fading health and inner struggles.

Entries.Title: Sponsor
Entries.Description: A movie about sisters who use their bodies to survive. To support her family, Jasmine becomes a sugar baby to a businessman. She regrets her choice as she learns that that it would put her and her sister's life in danger.

Entries.Title: In Between
Entries.Description: Shane and Gaila -- both bearing the baggage of being heartbroken -- decide to be each other's "in between" while they look for love in other places

Entries.Title: Bayo
Entries.Description: Can you mix business with pleasure? Claire definitely can. A new girl in town uses seduction and mind games  to tear a loving couple apart. Her motive: lust with a little bit of business.

Entries.Title: Walker
Entries.Description: VMX Crush Robb Guinto is out to seek justice. Haunted by her best friend's horrible murder, Alexa, an avenging prostitute uses herself as bait, sleeping with different kinds of men in order to track down the killer of her best friend.

Entries.Title: Ex Ex Lovers
Entries.Description: Joy travels to Valletta, Malta, to reunite with her ex-partner Ced, aiming to ask him to walk their daughter down the aisle, as per her request. However, their complicated past and unresolved issues lead to comedic and heartfelt moments as they navigate their rekindled interactions.

Entries.Title: Maninilip
Entries.Description: Alex, a young photographer, secretly documents his neighbors’ sex lives. But when he witnesses Luisa being abused by her husband, he uses his camera to help her—and becomes entangled in a passionate affair.

Entries.Title: Teacher's Pet
Entries.Description: Robin, a young student, is obsessed with Tanya, his teacher. He then sees Tanya kissing a female student, so he blackmails her. When Robin believes that he is in control, he learns Tanya's dark personality.

Entries.Title: Ligaya
Entries.Description: A former bar entertainer now lives a quiet life with her husband - until he loses his job. To survive, she returns to the world of adult entertainment, entering a voyeuristic club where everything slowly begins to fall apart.

Entries.Title: Tigkiliwi
Entries.Description: When young sisters Lala and Marlin were orphaned, nobody was there to help them except for an old woman rumored to be an Aswang.

Entries.Title: I Remember You
Entries.Description: Inspired by true stories, the movie is set in the scenic island of Boracay where Gani (Santos), a bank employee, is forced to return to the island he left to heal a broken heart. As he begins to create a new life, Debby (Montenegro), his ex, shows up.

Entries.Title: The Sunflower's Bloom
Entries.Description: A high school student, Mirasol finds herself drawn to her classmate Aries. She faces the consequences as she gives in to temptation.

Entries.Title: Quezon
Entries.Description: A historical drama focusing on Manuel L. Quezon years after the Philippine Revolution during the American occupation. When his fight for independence from the United States is put to the test, Quezon finds himself playing the brutal game of politics to outmaneuver his rivals — including Leonard Wood, Sergio Osmeña, and Joven Hernando. In Quezon’s relentless quest for power, he ultimately faces off with Emilio Aguinaldo in the 1935 presidential elections, using charm and favoritism as both weapons and currency, in a campaign that ultimately changes the face of Philippine politics and history.

Entries.Title: Delusyon
Entries.Description: A desperate wife whose husband is shot after a robbery attempt. Desperate to help him financially, she turns to Kap, a man who's always been interested in her, sparking an affair that shatters their relationships.

Entries.Title: And the Breadwinner Is...
Entries.Description: A mistaken identity leads to a promising opportunity when breadwinner Bambi comes home to her own funeral. Instead of correcting the comical mistake, Bambi, together with her dysfunctional family, decide to keep up the ridiculous act of her death in order to claim her 10 million peso life insurance in hopes of finally turning their dream life to reality.

Entries.Title: Open Endings
Entries.Description: OPEN ENDINGS follows four queer women in their 30s who are exes turned best friends as they navigate adulthood, love, friendship, chosen families, and everything in between.

Entries.Title: Kolektor
Entries.Description: Jessie, a single man trying to look for love. But it seems like all his dates end up missing. Find out his and his family’s dark secret in this dangerously erotic award-winning film.

Entries.Title: Journeyman
Entries.Description: In the unforgiving world of professional boxing, Angelo, a journeyman known for throwing fights to settle debts and support his family, balances his nights as a factory laborer with a desperate bid for redemption and dignity inside the ring, challenging the corrupt system that controls his fate.

Entries.Title: Puri for Rent
Entries.Description: Aiko Garcia plays a desperate woman thrust into an unusual job. In desperate need of money after getting fired, Nancy finds herself accepting a job as a young and rich disabled man’s sexual partner. But can she let go of her dignity when the sex leads to love?

Entries.Title: Lasting Moments
Entries.Description: Aki and Pia are a devoted couple working hard to build a future together. Pia, driven by love and a desire to lift her family from poverty, is offered a prestigious job in Singapore by her boss Carlo—who harbors feelings for her. As Pia’s career flourishes, Aki’s life unravels, leading to addiction and their painful breakup. Five years later, Pia is successful but unfulfilled in a relationship with the controlling Carlo. She returns to the Philippines, rejects his proposal, and seeks out Aki—only to find a man who no longer seems to know her. Faced with regret, Pia must confront the cost of her choices and the love she may have lost forever.

Entries.Title: Sunshine
Entries.Description: Just days before her team's tryouts for the Olympics, dedicated young gymnast Sunshine discovers she is pregnant. Now she must embark on a desperate and risky journey to fight for her dream.

Entries.Title: Sex On Phone
Entries.Description: Amanda, compelled to make ends meet, gets employed in a confidential call center where she fulfills the desires of her callers. When her husband finds out about her odd job, things become chaotic.

Entries.Title: Only We Know
Entries.Description: When retired English teacher Betty faces the quiet uncertainty of life after work, she forms an unlikely bond with Ryan, a grief-stricken structural engineer in his 40s, mourning the sudden loss of his wife. As they navigate loneliness, societal judgement and their own emotional scars, is their deepening friendship just a lifeline or will it reveal a kind of love they didn’t know they need?

Entries.Title: Some Nights I Feel Like Walking
Entries.Description: Some Nights I Feel Like Walking tells the story of a rich teenager who runs away from home and joins a group of street hustlers who go on a road trip to fulfill the final wish of their dead friend.

Entries.Title: Tusok Tusok
Entries.Description: A barbecue vendor who is forced by her boyfriend to sell something more. Behind her struggling food business is a booming special service gig that lures men to get hooked on her.

Entries.Title: Kiss/Kiss
Entries.Description: Hosted by Micaella Raz and Zsara Laxamana. Your favorite VMX crushes kiss, lick, and tease each other in the sexiest girl-on-girl scenes ever caught on camera. Every touch is electric. Every moan, real.

Entries.Title: Sinagtala
Entries.Description: The stage is set. The music is loud. But behind the melody lies a story of dreams, struggles, and unbreakable bonds.

Entries.Title: Republika ng Pipolipinas
Entries.Description: When the local government threatens to evict her from her own land, a farmer renounces her Filipino citizenship and builds her own micronation.

Entries.Title: Hiram
Entries.Description: Grace and Ivy are half-sisters who finally reunite in New Zealand. But as they begin to share this new life together, that may also include sharing one man.

Entries.Title: Cinemartyrs
Entries.Description: A young filmmaker is bent on recreating forgotten massacres from Philippine history, but when she begins shooting at a site where 1,000 men, women, and children were slaughtered, angry spirits are awakened and the lives of her team and the local villagers are put in peril.

Entries.Title: The Last Goodbye
Entries.Description: It takes us back to the early 2000s, where handwritten letters held unspoken emotions, and love was both beautiful and fleeting. It follows the story of two souls drawn together by pain, healed by love, yet tested by fate.

Entries.Title: Online Selling
Entries.Description: Two women, Melissa and Osang, sell sex items on the black market with "extra service". Melissa's life takes a sensual turn when a past lover becomes her customer and is out to get her back.

Entries.Title: Olsen's Day
Entries.Description: A production assistant goes on a trip with a strange old man and his son who threatens him but at the same time, gives him the answers he seeks.

Entries.Title: Foreign Exchange
Entries.Description: Details here

Entries.Title: Lilim
Entries.Description: Evading the police, Issa and her brother Tomas seek shelter in a secluded orphanage in the forest. But the siblings’ safe haven soon reveals itself to be a hellscape controlled by a sacrificial cult in thrall to a fearsome nocturnal deity.

Entries.Title: Call Me Mother
Entries.Description: Twinkle wants to surprise her adopted son Angel with a trip to Disneyland, but his adoption isn’t final yet. With three months left for someone to claim him, things take a turn when Mara shows up. Desperate not to lose him, Twinkle goes all out—sometimes in wild and funny ways—to prove she’s the best mom for Angel.

Entries.Title: Tokyo Nights
Entries.Description: Newlywed couple Kara and Max are on their honeymoon when they encounter Kara's ex-boyfriend. Their honeymoon turns even spicier and toured around by Kara's ex-boyfriend.

Entries.Title: Doce de Pebrero
Entries.Description: Thirty years after the massacre of Doce de Pebrero in 1945, an aging survivor struggles to maintain his quiet life as he is haunted by the shadows of his past-memories of violence and fear that refuse to fade, forcing him to confront the lasting scars of his trauma.

Entries.Title: Lily
Entries.Description: John, a quiet and mysterious photographer, is driving along the vibrant and crowded streets of Manila when he meets Lily, a shrewd sex worker with a disarming beauty.

Entries.Title: Child No. 82
Entries.Description: During the wake of the biggest action-fantasy movie star of Philippine Cinema, a persevering 16-year-old high school student needs to prove that he is his 82nd child

Entries.Title: Abanse
Entries.Description: The night before local elections, a single mother takes her son to a final campaign rally to get his lost scholarship back — unaware that in the midst of the dense crowd, a morbid disaster awaits them.

Entries.Title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
Entries.Description: In the slums of Manila, 11-year-old Ginto dreams of gang life over scavenging, rejecting his sister Asia’s care as she turns to sex work to survive. As Ginto falls for another boy in the gang, he’s forced to confront his identity and desires amid violence and poverty. Meanwhile, Dutch tourist Michael, consumed by dark impulses, descends into the city’s red-light district. When their paths cross, Ginto faces an impossible choice that will shape both their fates in a world where innocence is currency and survival comes at a cost.

Entries.Title: Asog
Entries.Description: This unique narrative incorporating documentary elements follows Rey, a 40-year-old non-binary teacher and typhoon survivor, on a roadtrip to fame. With surreal comedy and social portrait realism, filmmaker Seán‌ Devlin explores climate change, LGBTQ+ issues, and the impact of colonialism on contemporary Philippines.

Entries.Title: Uwian
Entries.Description: A woman consumed by a hoarding obsession roams the streets, collecting objects she believes will be useful when her son, missing for three years, finally returns home.

Entries.Title: As the Hydra Devours History
Entries.Description: “Habang Nilalamon ng Hydra ang Kasaysayan” (As the Hydra Devours History) tells the story of four Filipinos grappling with their place in the world and struggling to come to terms with the new realities they are faced with. The film is an existentialist drama where people who have lost hope attempt to find meaning in an absurd, indifferent, and paradoxical universe.

Entries.Title: Night Light
Entries.Description: Five days before the declaration of Martial Law, the collapse of the Colgante Bridge in Naga forced Doring, a father, to confront his deepest fear — the loss of his son, Ivan, in a tragedy that recalls the darkness of the past.

Entries.Title: La Viuda
Entries.Description: Married to an elderly man widowed several times with lots of dirty secrets. Sophia became a victim of domestic violence. She’s determined to fight every step of the way. Will she succeed or end up with nothing?

Entries.Title: waiting until the dawn
Entries.Description: A grieving man writes a heartfelt eulogy for his late lover, grappling with the courage to publicly say goodbye to the love of his life—a man who never accepted his true identity.

Entries.Title: CALLING 84843
Entries.Description: Set in the late 2000s, a payphone booth at an all-girls Catholic school stands witness to the intimate performance of its callers.

Entries.Title: Coding si Papa
Entries.Description: In a small rural town, 9-year-old Gelo comes up with a plan to earn enough money to buy his tricycle-driver father a day off—so he can watch Gelo perform a poem written just for him at the school’s poetry contest.

Entries.Title: Phantosmia
Entries.Description: A counselor/psychiatrist suspects a lingering case of phantosmia, a phantom smell, and possibly caused by a deep psychological fracture.

Entries.Title: Dela Cruz, Juan P.
Entries.Description: After being forced to resign from his previous job, Juan attempts to apply for a new one with absurd qualifications.

Entries.Title: For When I Think, There is This Heaviness That I Would Rather You Not Carry
Entries.Description: A very short story about creative block.

Entries.Title: Naglalakad sa Maliwanag na Buwan
Entries.Description: A short film by Russel Royo.

Entries.Title: Her Locket
Entries.Description: Jewel Ouyang was once an actress and the daughter of a wealthy Chinese businessman until she suffered from dementia and lost everything. She is being cared for by his lawyer son, Kyle  Nicolas, who later hired Teresa Firmante, a caregiver who desires to undergo rhinoplasty to  escape her present life. One morning, Jewel stumbles upon a locket necklace containing an old  photo of herself with her parents. Teresa soon realizes that this locket is aiding Jewel in slowly  recalling her memories of the past – her childhood, her mischievous adolescence, her husband,  and her dysfunctional relationship with her older brother, Magnus Ouyang, whom she believes  forged their deceased father, Jasper Ouyang's, last will and testament in order to keep her out of  the inheritance. Jewel seeks out vengeance and retribution as she later faces Magnus in court.

Entries.Title: City's Laundry and Taxes
Entries.Description: In a small town outside of Manila in 2017, a laundromat owner's son finds his missing classmate's ID in a police uniform's dirty laundry.

Entries.Title: There Was Something Here Once
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Missing Necktie
Entries.Description: Grace, a fresh graduate, searches for her missing necktie the day before an important interview and finds pieces of her past instead.

Entries.Title: Buhusan
Entries.Description: From a Mindanao legend that reincarnated—split into twin girls, one defiant & one conforming as they live along the streets of Iligan City, testing the extremities of their morals, with fate dooming their life to live in a city of waterfalls, without water.

Entries.Title: Ang Limangdaan ni Mama
Entries.Description: For a day of small decisions, a five-hundred bill is the cost of being forgotten—and of a mother taken for granted.

Entries.Title: Left Cross
Entries.Description: Ric attempts to fulfill his dying grandson's final wish in exchange for something anybody would never expect.

Entries.Title: Honey, My Love, So Sweet
Entries.Description: In a decaying cinema in the heart of Manila, Life discovers first love through films and their new friend’s father.

Entries.Title: Firefly
Entries.Description: The film follows an old man who looks back on a fleeting love that illuminated his life, only for it to vanish without a trace.

Entries.Title: Champ Green
Entries.Description: In a small farming town, a graduating high school girl struggles to convince her distrustful father to allow her to continue her studies in college after her older sister gets pregnant while being sent to the same university.

Entries.Title: HonesTEA is the Best Policy!
Entries.Description: A college student is found dead in a secluded playground, leaving behind a milk tea drink and a rosary.

Entries.Title: Ukit
Entries.Description: An estranged grandson and his grieving grandfather reconnect through an unfinished bucket list, healing old wounds and rebuilding their bond.

Entries.Title: in case you miss it
Entries.Description: A high school campus journalist navigates his now strained relationship with his best friend after the unauthorized publication of his disapproved article.

Entries.Title: Iris
Entries.Description: Set in the 1960s, where Caloocan stands at the cusp of transformation, there’s a story of an ordinary Filipino family who faces their own reckoning with change, the Asuncion family. Iris, the middle child, returns home after receiving news of his mother’s death, stepping back into a home—and a city—that feels both familiar and distant.

Entries.Title: Temptations of the Flesh
Entries.Description: A jilted housewife uncovers a horrifying secret about her husband when he tries her adobong puti.

Entries.Title: For I Have Sinned
Entries.Description: Two Catholic school girls skip class to take a pregnancy test in a school bathroom, but as they wait for the result, buried fears, secrets, and shame surface, threatening their friendship and innocence.

Entries.Title: Kung Ika'y Makapili
Entries.Description: In the final days of the Japanese occupation in the Philippines, a young Filipino seeking to provide for his family by identifying traitors, finds a young insurgent living in his home, leaving him to choose between his family or dignity to survive the Second World War.

Entries.Title: Tahan
Entries.Description: A story about longing, about words left unsaid, about the quiet heartbreak of loving someone who may never love you back. But most of all, it’s about finding your way, even when love makes coming home the hardest thing to do.

Entries.Title: Ang Aking Mga Anak
Entries.Description: A heartwarming and tear-jerking story of five children brought together by pain, bound together by hope.

Entries.Title: Sa Likod ng Tsapa
Entries.Description: Police Colonel Hansel Marantan is a battle-scarred police officer, accused and imprisoned for an operation gone wrong. He confronts the system that betrayed him as he seeks redemption and justice in a nation torn between loyalty and law.

Entries.Title: don't you forget
Entries.Description: Torn between bailing out her boyfriend and reaffirming her body, a trans woman chooses the world.

Entries.Title: Dear Tala, Love, Grandma Odesa
Entries.Description: Cheerful and ever-spirited, Lola Odesa never forgets to jot down even the smallest details of her day. But in the silence between her words, a question lingers—what is she truly trying to hold on to?

Entries.Title: Let's Go Somewhere Else
Entries.Description: Five years of silence end when former high school best friends, Ethan and Gio, both cramming for finals, unexpectedly reunite at a cafe. With the cafe closing early, they must go somewhere else, confronting the unresolved pain of their fractured past.

Entries.Title: Behind the Lens
Entries.Description: In a world of online fame built on likes and lies, an aspiring star must uncover the darkness behind the lens—before it swallows her whole.

Entries.Title: 4 Better or 4 Worse
Entries.Description: Desperate to escape her abuser, Jennifer undergoes a rushed, unplanned transition, forcing Tintoy, along with Barbara and Bianca, to confront their fears and uphold a vow to the person Jennifer once was.

Entries.Title: Maybe If We Reach the Clouds
Entries.Description: When a deceased pilot is brought to Catacutan Funeral Home, the two kids ponder about their own dreams to become pilots and reach the clouds. But after several tries and when the unexpected happened, they both faced challenges urging them to navigate through foreign emotions. It is a story that dives into dreams and friendship and explores the intangibility of grief through the lens of children.

Entries.Title: Mga Hutik kag Tinago
Entries.Description: In a small village, a young man and his friend set out to uncover the truth behind a family accused of being 'aswang,' only to discover the deeper, more mysterious tradition that binds them to the land, and the shocking secret that has been whispered for generations.

Entries.Title: Estranged
Entries.Description: Following her mother’s death, May, a young transgender woman reunites with her estranged father, but their chance at reconciliation is threatened as she faces a painful choice: deny her identity to preserve peace, or embrace her truth and risk losing him again.

Entries.Title: Celluloid Vision
Entries.Description: Through lucid dreams, Chiaro uses his subconscious as a form of escapism from his mundane life with his aunt and indolent father. However, memories from his forgotten childhood resurface as his subconscious reveals an aching truth about his past.

Entries.Title: Sa Luyo Sang Kalayo
Entries.Description: In the shadows of their past, a devoted mother and her son must confront their hidden struggles and dangerous choices as they fight to keep their bond strong and reclaim their future against all odds.

Entries.Title: Hey! That's My Pradah!
Entries.Description: On the day of her long-awaited job interview, Phearl's only pair of heels was stolen. She must race against time to find them (or another pair) and make it to the interview before she loses this opportunity once and for all.

Entries.Title: With What We Have
Entries.Description: Hardworking couples Jenna and Eddie strive to build a better life despite the struggles and challenges of life. When a violent storm threatens everything they worked for, they must rely on love, resilience, and their dream to start again.

Entries.Title: Ellie and Sol
Entries.Description: At the height of their relationship, two great friends since junior high school realize a significant life change may come sooner than later.

Entries.Title: TOGA SA METRO
Entries.Description: A tailor named Ricardo, a classic Filipino film enthusiast, embraces these toxic masculine ideas, cultures, and behaviors from the films he watches. His wife Linda and their worker Jun will soon face the consequences of these behaviors.

Entries.Title: Lazy Bird
Entries.Description: When two disillusioned twenty-somethings are set up by their parents on an awkward date, they form an unlikely bond over their failure to meet family expectations.

Entries.Title: Kristyan, Jesus, and the Cards
Entries.Description: One night, a religious freshman had his fate predicted only to find out it resonated with his situation.

Entries.Title: Malamaya
Entries.Description: Malamaya tells the story of a young Filipino boy struggling with hiding his gay identity. During a trip to the market, he encounters a new-found solace in makeup.

Entries.Title: good night, dad. i love you.
Entries.Description: An intoxicated graduating college student confronts her similarly inebriated father for the first time while waiting for him to drive them home.

Entries.Title: I Do
Entries.Description: Inside a wedding boutique, a couple preparing for marriage finds themselves divided by their conflicting views on life after 'I do.'

Entries.Title: Sa Pagitan Ng Mga Bituin

Entries.Description: Diego Loyzaga and Joel Torre go head to head in this action-packed movie about a former hit man trying to live a normal life when someone from his past sees him and puts his family and friends in danger. Can he sacrifice his new life to fight for the ones he loves?

Entries.Title: Green Bones
Entries.Description: A soon-to-be released criminal and a corrections officer is still grieving over the death of his sister opposing the prisoner's release.

Entries.Title: That Kind of Love
Entries.Description: A story about two imperfect people entangled by fate because of their search for love. The Love Coach extraordinaire, who profiles and points out the flaws of a conceited man who deems himself as Mr. Perfect, ends up in a deal to find him a match. As the big-hearted Coach Milagros "Mila" Maharlika and the dashing Corporate Executive Adam De Dios set their course to learn more about each other, unknowingly, love might have already found what they are both looking for.

Entries.Title: Pushcart Tales
Entries.Description: Employees and customers are trapped in a supermarket while, outside, a typhoon ravages the country. It's time for confidences and revelations. Zombies, they say, in a society that is not easy for any of them. In a limited space, they try to discover their stories. And that could be their last day.

Entries.Title: Salisihan
Entries.Description: When a childless couple lets a pregnant woman inside their home, temptation starts to shake their once peaceful life.

Entries.Title: Linya
Entries.Description: Gia is a struggling bartender who is also a kept woman of a politician. With a budding romance at work, Gia must fight the urge to see another man before it’s too late.

Entries.Title: Guilty Pleasure
Entries.Description: Guilty Pleasure explores the complex relationships and personal struggles of three ambitious lawyers as they navigate their way through love, betrayal, and ambition.

Entries.Title: One Night
Entries.Description: One night, two strangers meet in a bar. Karla just lost her husband, but she doesn't know how to deal with grief since her husband abuses her. Meanwhile, it's Dindo's last night as a free man because he will surrender himself to the authorities the next day. They get to talk before the night is over and they discover a shocking truth that binds them forever. This bond leads to the unraveling of dark secrets from their individual pasts, secrets that have kept them in misery.

Entries.Title: Table for 3
Entries.Description: Couple Paul and Marlon decide to jazz up their long-standing relationship by including the charismatic Jeremy as their third. The complexities of this new dynamic will reveal whether their bond will strengthen or will be torn apart.

Entries.Title: Isang Himala
Entries.Description: Amid drought and famine in Cupang, a young woman named Elsa claims to have seen the Virgin Mary and been blessed with the ability to heal the sick. As people flock to witness her powers, the village becomes consumed by faith, prosperity, greed, and deceit. Is Elsa a true symbol of hope in a world desperate for salvation? “Isang Himala” is a rousing adaptation of “Himala” (1982), written by National Artist Ricky Lee.

Entries.Title: Pretty Boys
Entries.Description: Pretty Boys is a romantic comedy following Grey, a flamboyant and charming twink, and his longtime best friend, Jonas, a heartthrob with a masculine appeal.

Entries.Title: Raya Among the Clouds
Entries.Description: Set in 2005, follows third-grader Raya Carpio as she struggles with stage fright and societal judgment during a school family showcase. When questions arise about her unconventional family, Raya hesitates to invite her mother, Sabel, to an upcoming Family Day. With the help of her friend Makoy, Raya sends heartfelt messages via paper airplanes, hoping to bridge their emotional gap. Though the plan falters, a heartfelt trip brings mother and daughter closer, revealing the depth of their bond.

Entries.Title: What Did the Sky Tell You, Celso?
Entries.Description: After discovering a hidden clause in his work insurance, CELSO, a factory worker, goes extreme and faces a life-altering decision, challenging reality to secure his family's future.

Entries.Title: Huwag Mo 'Kong Iwan
Entries.Description: The story of two ex-lovers who reunited, only to find themselves separated again when one of them gets embroiled in human trafficking and illegal drug trade.

Entries.Title: Ballad of a Blind Man
Entries.Description: Living alone as a caretaker to her ailing but overbearing dad, a demure and loving daughter unravels the secrets of her estranged mom as her dad’s grip on her life tightens.

Entries.Title: Radikals
Entries.Description: A young rookie from a bizarre chicken-dance group faces a heckler after being the worst dancer at a performance -- leading him to a series of strange events that reveal what the group does to their weakest link.

Entries.Title: Under Parallel Skies
Entries.Description: A man struggling with a painful past tries to move forward, only to discover that the woman in his present life has an uncanny connection to his past.

Entries.Title: Men Are From QC, Women Are From Alabang
Entries.Description: Two lovers navigate post-graduation life, facing challenges of long-distance relationship and career demands. Their perspectives on shared experiences diverge as physical and emotional distance grows, straining their bond over time.

Entries.Title: Una't Huling Sakay
Entries.Description: Francis, an inexperienced rider, meets a veteran habal rider, Dindo, and forms an unlikely brotherhood. In the process of taking their passengers to their whereabouts, can they also take themselves and find their ways to their life’s ultimate destination?

Entries.Title: Mi Unico Hijo
Entries.Description: A young man must choose between his mother's plans or to follow his lifelong goal as a session musician.

Entries.Title: Chances Are, You and I
Entries.Description: Sol Sikat is a young man burdened with a brain tumor and a bleak outlook on life. Haunted by loss and impending mortality, Sol lives in a state of weary resignation. Gabi Sinag is Sol’s opposite – a vibrant soul who radiates optimism despite her tumor diagnosis. Gabi’s spirit refuses to be extinguished by the reality of her illness, as she chases every chance for joy and dreams of a normal life.

Entries.Title: My Sassy Girl
Entries.Description: The film tells the love story of Junjee, and Sheena. Junjee just cannot seem to catch a romantic break. Their personalities stand opposite to the characteristics traditionally associated with masculinity and femininity in Asian societies in general.

Entries.Title: Vox Humana
Entries.Description: One of Filipino cinema's most remarkable new talents, Don Josephus Raphael Eblahan crafts his boldest vision yet: an utterly distinctive blend of science-fiction allegory and existential drama that yields a profound enquiry into human interconnectedness.

Entries.Title: Gitling
Entries.Description: While creating the subtitles of a film, a young Filipina translator and a middle-aged Japanese director test the limits of language and understanding.

Entries.Title: My Boyfriend is a Sex Worker
Entries.Description: This romantic dramedy highlights the relationship between Ace, the influential Mendoza family’s perfect son, and Gio, a gay porn content creator and sex worker. While they see themselves an ideal match, the uptight Mendoza matriarch Angelica doesn’t seem to think so.

Entries.Title: My Boyfriend is a Sex Worker 2
Entries.Description: Convinced that his beloved Gio left him for money, Ace’s life spirals downward as he drowns his sorrows in a drinking binge. Hopefully, a plan devised by Ace’s sister, Malou, can reignite their spark while keeping their meddling family at bay.

Entries.Title: A Crab From A Conch Shell
Entries.Description: In the aftermath of loss, an orphan girl flees her gloomy fate and is drawn to a mysterious light, leading her to a life reflection and a journey of intertwined destinies.

Entries.Title: Maria, Ina ng Diyos
Entries.Description: All her life, Yeshua spends her Holy Week break within the constraints of her room. Now in her last year of high school, she wishes to go with her friends to Batangas to spend the vacation together. Despite being estranged from her mother, Maria, Yeshua still tried to seek permission to go with her friends. However, due to their severed bond, Yeshua’s efforts go to waste and only cause their wounds to open up after years of pretending that they don’t exist.

Entries.Title: UNA
Entries.Description: A short film by PABLO

Entries.Title: Makamisa: Phantasm of Revenge
Entries.Description: In this whimsical historical fresco, a counterpoint to today’s urgent political issues, the figure of the Filipino revolutionary Rizal is revisited in the light of early silent films.

Entries.Title: Friendly Fire
Entries.Description: Hazel, an employee at an internet cafe who's a fan of Project Xandata (a real first-person shooter made in the Philippines) gets the attention of a pro team founder when Hazel beats her team single handedly in one night. Hazel’s game play goes viral, making her an instant sensation.

Entries.Title: Stay With Me
Entries.Description: This is a story of Gayle, an independent woman running her own AirBnb business. Breadwinner of the family; continuously longing for love, care and affection.

Entries.Title: More Than Just Ripples
Entries.Description: Caught in a creative struggle, a painter confronts her traumatic past and unfulfilled dreams when commissioned to paint seascape art, leading her on a journey of self-discovery through the depths of the sea and uncharted waters of her own.

Entries.Title: 21st Birthday
Entries.Description: Three former high school best friends reunite four years later in college. Their short reunion grows tenser as they recall something from their past.

Entries.Title: The Red Dress
Entries.Description: In Japan, a Filipina migrant is chosen by a haunted dress to be its new owner and is manipulated into hunting down the murderer of the previous owner.

Entries.Title: As My Sun Sets
Entries.Description: A lonesome teenager goes through a difficult stage of detachment from the forbidden love towards his best friend that caused their circle of friendship to be in ruins; painfully recalling the joyous moments of the past and yearning to bring back the once fruitful friendship.

Entries.Title: Little One
Entries.Description: A pregnant mother, unsure of how to raise a child, arranges an interview with her two gay dads but fate intervenes when his dad suffers a heart attack. Her dad reflects on their family's history, captured on an old camcorder.

Entries.Title: Ang Persneym ni Dyunyor
Entries.Description: When a pregnant couple finds themselves at odds over their unborn son's name, tensions escalate as the girl insists on naming him after her dead mother, while the guy eagerly advocates for a biblical moniker.

Entries.Title: Ang Halikan Sa Water Fountain
Entries.Description: A silly bromance sparks out of the closeness of two laidback high school boys, Maki and Kaloy. When a night of reckless drinking with their friends leads them to share a bed together, they discover the true nature of their bromance and now must decide whether to embrace this or risk losing each other's friendship.

Entries.Title: When the World Met Miss Probinsyana
Entries.Description: Marge, a determined young woman from the province who breaks into the male-dominated BPO industry. As a symbol of innovation and empowerment, she returns to her roots to uplift her community by establishing her own BPO business. Alongside her partner Wil, Marge skillfully handles the challenges of entrepreneurship and societal expectations.

Entries.Title: When the Pigs Storm our Houses
Entries.Description: Two boys, Kulas and Gabo, enjoy playing games together until an impending demolition of their community threatens their relationship.

Entries.Title: KOLATERAL
Entries.Description: High school student, Adie Gonzales, doesn’t care much about politics, until a haunting dream pulls her into a terrifying reality. Driven by a newfound sense of purpose, Adie is thrown into a world of fear and danger. Will she find the strength to confront the darkness and reveal the truth, or will she become its next victim?

Entries.Title: as i await you to be mine...
Entries.Description: An experimental lo-fi love story told through still photographs, an unseen character longingly admires a young woman from afar.

Entries.Title: Shortest Day, Longest Night
Entries.Description: On the night of the opening of his new exhibit, a queer artist who has just gotten out of an abusive relationship makes a connection with another troubled soul.

Entries.Title: All This Wasted Space
Entries.Description: The search for a burial token for her mother forces a woman to dig up a buried past and confront the house she abandoned for 11 years. As she descends, the house speaks to her.

Entries.Title: Bata, Batak Ka Pa
Entries.Description: A young boy's innocence is slowly deprived by digital overstimulation and the War on Drugs. Surrounded by a world of vices, his future becomes uncertain when he learns the truth about the people around him.

Entries.Title: Beneath the Firefly Veil
Entries.Description: In a remote community, a girl named Joy faces a menacing land grabber, Rommel, who violently coerces her grandfather into selling their ancestral land, culminating in a dramatic and harrowing confrontation that threatens their future.

Entries.Title: Occupied
Entries.Description: A bright young student who is deeply troubled by his intrusive thoughts is summoned by his strict teacher to confront him about his failing grades.

Entries.Title: Kaleidoscope
Entries.Description: Two broken pieces from the same broken glass cascading upon a kaleidoscope of events with each twist and turn, a new shade upon their lives, seeking solace in the embrace of the familiar yet unknown. The only thing holding them together is hope, beyond the realm of almighty, echoing through eternity's expanse. Is this existence tangible, truth, or merely ethereal lantasies cloaked in the desires of what might have been?

Entries.Title: Afterimage
Entries.Description: Experiencing extreme sleep deprivation for months, a young man tape-records his memories for preservation against sinister, clandestine watchers.

Entries.Title: Alaga
Entries.Description: Gloria, a middle-aged seamstress, and her son Bayani live in the House, a structure in constant decay. As Bayani’s birthday approaches, mother, son, and the House are forced to confront their innermost desires.

Entries.Title: Abandoned Lullabies
Entries.Description: After receiving a text from his father, Axl, a grief-stricken guy must return to his province to resolve what remains after his mother's death, causing him to descend into the depths of his past.

Entries.Title: Tumandok
Entries.Description: Despite contentions from historians, legend has it that in ancient times, an Ati chieftain traded their land to Bornean datus for a necklace and a wide-brimmed hat made of gold. The mountains were left to the Atis, while the plains and rivers went to the Malays. Today, even the mountains are under threat, sometimes violently taken from the Atis.

Entries.Title: You'll Return in May
Entries.Description: A distressed college student confronts his lover about the events that led to their separation.

Entries.Title: They Call Me Monique
Entries.Description: Haunted by a toxic past, Kimberly Salazar sees the damage yet remains entangled in its patterns. Desperate for escape, she takes a job that ultimately leads her back to the very place she tried to leave behind.

Entries.Title: Ka Benjie
Entries.Description: The quiet life of the dreamer Ka Benjie was shattered when he heard of the enrollment in the other village.

Entries.Title: PNB 12-50
Entries.Description: After Typhoon Pablo struck a barangay in New Bataan, Compostela Valley, a father was separated from his only daughter. Whether alive or dead, the father is determined to find his daughter's body to the very end.

Entries.Title: Last Farewell
Entries.Description: A woman in her 30's strikes up an unconventional relationship after she received a corpse to embalm.

Entries.Title: Alpas
Entries.Description: Alunsina, a young artist struggling with grief, isolates herself, finding solace in her art. Her  partner, Kalel, appears to offer comfort, helping her confront her pain. In a moment of  vulnerability, Alunsina opens up, allowing herself to reconnect and take the first steps toward  healing and closure.

Entries.Title: Mahanduraw ko Nimo
Entries.Description: A little girl dreams of seeing her father until she finds his image in a painting.

Entries.Title: Water Ballet
Entries.Description: Trapped by his parent’s relentless argument, a teenager isolates himself in the bathroom and finds solace in the confined space of the bathtub.

Entries.Title: Misterio De Familia
Entries.Description: In a small town where everyone knows each other, the Hernandez family struggles to bury a dangerous secret. In hopes to cover it up and start anew, would they succeed or will they only add it to their growing list of dark secrets?

Entries.Title: Amping
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of Myca, a student who turns to stealing after losing her job due to a revelation about her father. Living under her parents' roof, she only has her mother by her side, and together they manage to get by. Along with her friends Mark, Adora, and Baron, Myca finds ways to survive. In their precarious situation, the friends rely on each other until one of them betrays the group. The story follows how these friends test their loyalty and uncover the truth.

Entries.Title: How to Make a College?
Entries.Description: After misspelling 'collage' as 'college', a young boy inquires about what college is in his local neighborhood where nobody has ever attended university.

Entries.Title: Tani
Entries.Description: Tacatani runs a YouTube series, "Sari-Saring Kwento," where guests share the words they never got to say. During one of these interviews, she's confronted with a story that feels all too familiar, leading her to reflect on memories long buried and emotions left unsaid. Some stories hold more meaning than we initially understand, and the weight of unspoken words lingers in ways we might never expect.

Entries.Title: Laban Jo
Entries.Description: Late at night, a high schooler named Jo quietly packs a costume into his backpack. He argues with his friend about quitting varsity and becoming a superhero. Suddenly, breaking news of a hostage situation plays on Joaquin’s laptop as he zips down his backpack. Jo tries to sneak out but is confronted by his father, Inigo, who knows the truth. The confrontation escalates and Jo tries to storm out, but he is stopped by an enraged and unresponsive Inigo.

Entries.Title: beats purr minute
Entries.Description: In summer solstice, a girl connects with a cat and discovers what it means to be together, in unison and with one's self.

Entries.Title: Liban
Entries.Description: A selfish boss finds her counterpart in the form of her employee who puts his feet on the ground after losing her wallet on the street one night.

Entries.Title: lola.psd
Entries.Description: An unlikely friendship forms when a fifteen-year-old graphic designer helps his stubborn grandmother digitally color her old black-and-white photos. But as they bicker and bond through each photo, they soon realize that memories are anything, but black-and-white.

Entries.Title: KIYAW
Entries.Description: On the blood-stained ruins of a seedy 1945 Manila. Horrors unfold in the eyes of a mother from a farming village after being enslaved to satisfy the Japanese Soldiers' fetish for the interplay of sex and violence. Her daring Iron Will led her to fight and resist in order to survive.

Entries.Title: Not Like Other Girls
Entries.Description: A Serene Film

Entries.Title: The Reply Project
Entries.Description: As she swipes from adolescence to adulthood, chronically online @usernoname is finally confronted by notifications of all the situations she ignored, along with the thoughts she should have sent to people she no longer has contact with.

Entries.Title: Gintong Buhay
Entries.Description: A year after her grandmother’s death, Isla, a graduating literature student, comes back to Mindoro and reckons with the void her grandmother left as she finds and listens to her “nanay’s” recorded poems and songs when she cleans up her nanay’s untouched bedroom, in line with a Mindoreno tradition.

Entries.Title: Dali's Chime
Entries.Description: Lani works as a barista in a café. Her best friend Dali tags along. They engage in idle joy while a chime is heard in the background, ringing against their interior world.

Entries.Title: Nothing Much
Entries.Description: Two sisters, in hopes of fresher air, decide to sit on a bench under the shade of a tree.

Entries.Title: Paralysis in Motion
Entries.Description: A man struggles to survive a routinary life as the line between reality and a mobile game blurs.

Entries.Title: Piggyback
Entries.Description: Tina, 21, tries to find her boyfriend who got her pregnant, hesitating to confess to her mother she gets to decide whether to abort the child or face the consequences of reality.

Entries.Title: MUGGED
Entries.Description: Set in 2022 in an urban city, Totoy is the grandchild of a cobbler in a place where no one has shoes; his curiosity begins when his grandfather tells him about the lore of a fairy who continuously robs shoes and controls the economic stability of the barangay. Totoy is driven to know the answers. Through the story of his grandfather, Totoy notices that his grandfather was rewarded to become a cobbler with the expectation of improving the standard of living, only to find out that the place is under the curse of the fairy and realize only Totoy could break the curse.

Entries.Title: Again
Entries.Description: After the EDSA People Power Revolution, two unnamed male lovers meet in a particular room reminiscing about their lives after one of them was taken away by armed men during the Philippines’ Martial Law period. The disappeared talks of violence and life under captivity, while the other one talks of his life waiting and searching. The story unfolds towards their decisions on how they’d like to pursue their relationship given the circumstances, hopefully towards a more peaceful time together again.

Entries.Title: Sa Sulod sang Luka-it nga Gal-um
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hindi Lahat ng Rosas ay Pula
Entries.Description: It's always calmest in the eye of the storm. Anna had always lived a quiet and secluded life, oblivious of the many things that make the world turn. Left to choose between the comfort of familiarity and the bitterness of the truth, she gets thrown to a rude awakening.

Entries.Title: Brownout Capital
Entries.Description: In the outskirts of Palawan, a man hunts for ice after dark while a woman struggles to keep her ice business afloat amidst erratic electricity. Brownout Capital delves into the lives of locals coping with the constant power outages in their hometown.

Entries.Title: Quiapo Blues
Entries.Description: A student becomes a target of accusations, leading to infamy and social isolation. His best friend steps-in to challenge societal prejudices into his own hands.

Entries.Title: It Will Rain Tomorrow
Entries.Description: A call center agent named Ali delves on her past and present to celebrate her anniversary with her husband, Migs.

Entries.Title: Until Then
Entries.Description: Poy, a second-gen migrant and Shirley, an exhausted local, strike an unlikely connection and wander through Manila at night.

Entries.Title: Litraso
Entries.Description: An artist holds a pen on paper and slowly starts drawing the line. The line gradually increases its pace, leading to curves, reversions, curveballs, and inconsistencies. As the artist nearly finishes, the artist lifts the pen to show the entire drawing. The artist slowly returns to drawing and continues the following chapters of life.

Entries.Title: Mananguete
Entries.Description: Centered around the diminishing trade of the Mananguete, the story unfolds against the backdrop of Nilo’s encroaching memory loss, a devoted father, racing against time to carve out a brighter future for his son.

Entries.Title: Praying Mantis
Entries.Description: A female praying mantis faces a moral dilemma when considering a romantic involvement with a playful male who, surprisingly, is aiding her in finding another mate instead of him.

Entries.Title: Aninaw
Entries.Description: Three friends return to their hometown to fulfill a promise to their deceased friend, only to stumble upon a mysterious riddle promising to fulfill their deepest desires. They soon embark on a journey as they rediscover their past.

Entries.Title: Reverie
Entries.Description: A friend group attempts to keep their bond alive and strong as they prepare for the last culminating activity before the academic year comes to an end.

Entries.Title: Pa'no sa Susunod na Brownout?
Entries.Description: When a brownout disrupts their digital routine, Ta and Rina are forced to confront each other as buried tensions in their relationship come to light.

Entries.Title: Silab ng Pira-pirasong Alaala
Entries.Description: In a household ruled by a domineering patriarch, a young reserved woman clings on to a cassette tape gifted by someone from her past – reliving their shared moments of love and defiance to find her own path.

Entries.Title: Art Gave the World a Voice
Entries.Description: A young artist journals her surroundings in an attempt to discover the meaning of art.

Entries.Title: Prince of Tides
Entries.Description: As the land begins to slip back into the sea, young Kiko shares a bittersweet farewell with his grandfather, each holding onto memories of a home slowly being reclaimed by the tides.

Entries.Title: Tumba Lata
Entries.Description: Fresca aspires to live with the dream of becoming a police officer and achieving a better life after losing her youth to extreme poverty. Fate unexpectedly makes a fool out of her when the dreams she craved the most led to her demise in the dark and cruel reality of the world in which she lives.

Entries.Title: Lola, Lola, Paano Ba 'Yan?
Entries.Description: As Gelo spends time doing ceramics with Lola Luz, he learns more about his mother’s experiences and struggles.

Entries.Title: Lady of the Night
Entries.Description: Lea, in her late 20s, finds herself caught between loyalty to her country and her humanity as she entertains Japanese soldiers, discovering the true cost of war and the price of survival.

Entries.Title: Bang Bang Bang Patay ka na Patay ka na!
Entries.Description: A child catches a glimpse of an action film as it slowly devours his reality.

Entries.Title: Ripples of Regret
Entries.Description: In a peaceful seaside town, a family of four living along the shorelines suffers the devastating consequences of a nearby factory’s actions. This factory, notorious for emitting toxic chemicals, continuously leaks waste into the sea, polluting the waters and putting the lives of the local community at risk. The film follows the pain and suffering endured by the family’s mother as she reflects on the past, struggles in the present, and longs for a future where her family is still alive.

Entries.Title: Cat Fruit
Entries.Description: Gabriel makes sure his apartment is tidy before he takes his own life, until an unfamiliar cat trespasses and messes up the whole place again.

Entries.Title: still waters
Entries.Description: Seph and Vivian, estranged siblings with vastly different personalities, are forced to confront their deeply ingrained familial trauma when Seph starts moving into Vivian's dorm for college.

Entries.Title: Voicemails For The Unknown Receiver
Entries.Description: Through phone call conversations, an aspiring Ilocano filmmaker relates to his mother working in Italy about his dreams and struggles while documenting the invisible betweenness of their language and distance.

Entries.Title: Memories of the Collapsed Land
Entries.Description: The quest of a scientist in exploring loss, tragedy, and aspirations, on the land of where memories were crumpled and collapsed.

Entries.Title: anayad
Entries.Description: A Serene Film

Entries.Title: Bilog ang Bulan
Entries.Description: A mother prepares her child before she abandons her. Because today, on the night of the full moon, she will become a monster.

Entries.Title: Bucket List
Entries.Description: Two orphaned siblings try to fulfill the short “bucket list” they made together before one of them dies.

Entries.Title: Girlhood Golagat
Entries.Description: Four childhood acquaintances from different walks of life reunited in their friend's resthouse, revealing their struggles to fit in the society.

Entries.Title: sa likod ng salamin
Entries.Description: A local barbershop will be closing soon after serving for 28 years. Rey, the barber, has decided to open his shop for one last time. His last day will reveal his true purpose in life.

Entries.Title: Patricia
Entries.Description: Trauma reporter Patricia Evangelista had a front-row view of the harshness and cruelty brought upon the lives of those who became victims of the Drug War under Duterte's administration. Witnessing the aftermath of violent killings, she struggles with the emotional toll of reporting on the victims and their families. Now, Patricia has no other choice but to persist and struggle amidst the grappling difficulties of fighting her internal battles and fighting the battles of those people whose stories she carries in every article and paper she writes.

Entries.Title: Hudas
Entries.Description: Follows the story of a school paper's new editor-in-chief who begins to slowly spiral out of control due to the influence of a mysterious new member of his team.

Entries.Title: Pauraray
Entries.Description: In a small town where the whispers of the wind carried the weight of secrets, two young souls found solace in each other's presence.  Original Composition by Lux.

Entries.Title: Liwanag sa Karaniwan
Entries.Description: Ambitious and driven, Solano excels in everything he tries but struggles to master anything. As the pressure to succeed builds, his world begins to unravel, leading him to question what truly matters.

Entries.Title: Session
Entries.Description: Three people, three different stories, but one question: "why are you here?". Strangers by face but destined to listen to their deepest, darkest wounds—Gab, Karl, and Alex offer comfort to each other through a free counseling session with a social worker.

Entries.Title: When's The Last Day of Grieving?
Entries.Description: Shaun makes a trip to Binondo to navigate through the process of grieving and faces the hard truth of being alone.

Entries.Title: Dakit
Entries.Description: Boyet, a 62-year-old grief- striken, disabled man, seeks to find the river where he lost his memories, runs on a surreal journey when a paperboat leads him to confront his past and find hope in the face profound loss

Entries.Title: Ang Puso Kong Ninakaw ng Recto
Entries.Description: A Serene Film

Entries.Title: Tagapagmasid
Entries.Description: Thea, an alien from a different planet, was sent to Earth to observe and determine humanity's worthiness to join the galactic stage. She is befriended by a group of students and learns about what it means to be human.

Entries.Title: Wheel
Entries.Description: "Gulong" is a poignant story depicting the conflicts and trials faced by impoverished individuals. It highlights the reality that those at society's lower levels encounter severe hardships, where the constant drive to survive impedes genuine communication. Like the relentless turning of a jeepney’s wheel, the narrative mirrors the challenging cycle of life, underscoring the phrase "Mahirap maging mahirap." Yet, amid all this, there is still hope that the opportunity to rise and fulfill one’s dreams will one day arrive.

Entries.Title: Whisper in the Woods
Entries.Description: A little girl finds a necklace that grants magical powers.

Entries.Title: Sa Ikatulo Nga Adlaw Muulan Balik
Entries.Description: Aya, a Kataw, returns home to protect what she loves.

Entries.Title: Leng Leng
Entries.Description: Lein, the only daughter of the Lao Family, seeks to commemorate the death of her younger brother during the pandemic. As the story unfolds, a hidden truth will be revealed and the love, trust, and bond of the family falters— she loses parts of herself.

Entries.Title: Maskara: THESIS
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Senakulo 2024: Traslacion
Entries.Description: This biblical drama tells the journey of a religious mother and her young son and how it closely reenacts the chronicled accounts of Christ’s life. Beneath the hardships the two face are life lessons that would lead them to spiritual enlightenment.

Entries.Title: Sa Hindi Paghahangad
Entries.Description: Pressured by upcoming life changes, two friends discover that there is more to life than just the future that awaits.

Entries.Title: Layag sa Pangarap
Entries.Description: Sean struggles to navigate the winds of his aspirations against the currents of his father’s expectations. He is torn between setting sail for his dreams or being anchored to his father’s vision of him becoming a marine.

Entries.Title: Tuhog
Entries.Description: Abie mourns after the death of Michael. She finds solace from her supposedly soon-to-be father-in-law, Roldan, and starts falling for him. But when Michael returns, their world turns upside down.

Entries.Title: Suki
Entries.Description: A lady stripper and a gigolo promised each other that their work can't break them apart. But when lust and temptation come into the picture, they begin to question their vow.

Entries.Title: Foursome
Entries.Description: A married couple having troubles in bed, finding their sexual satisfaction outside their marriage.

Entries.Title: Kamadora
Entries.Description: Ica works as a sales lady in a department store. With her charm and sex appeal, she gets the attention of her male boss. But unknown to everyone, a dark persona lies under her beautiful face.

Entries.Title: Torn Heaven
Entries.Description: Cousins Dyosa and Claudia's lives change when a carnival arrives in their town. As they both surrender their innocence to the carnival men, their dreams come crashing down.

Entries.Title: Sugapa
Entries.Description: Young lovers chase their big city dreams but get tested by lust, addiction, and the hunger for money. Will their love survive, or will reaching for their dreams tear them apart?

Entries.Title: Tayuan
Entries.Description: Ella, an events project manager, usually takes a private transportation service. However, she is forced to take a bus, where bus conductor Rico becomes aroused when her body gets pressed into him due to the thick crowd.  This encounter deeply affects Ella, and from that night on, she starts pursuing Rico. Even after discovering that Rico already has a live-in partner and a daughter, Ella doesn’t care at all and she’ll do anything to make him want her just as much.

Entries.Title: Flirtatious
Entries.Description: When a young lady experiences sexual awakening, she’ll find it hard to resist temptation - even if it means sleeping with her mother's boyfriend.

Entries.Title: Rewind
Entries.Description: Mary loves John for as long as she can remember. But after years of marriage, John's priorities shift, leading to a strained relationship with Mary, which causes a tragic accident that takes away Mary's life. Until one day, John gets an extraordinary proposition - to rewind time and save the life of the woman he loves.

Entries.Title: Mang Kanor
Entries.Description: Old businessman who finds himself in a scandal after his sex videos with women went viral.

Entries.Title: Vagrant
Entries.Description: A couple’s struggling marriage due to the husband’s sexual incapacity takes an unexpected turn when they save a homeless man from a violent assault. As they offer him shelter, the three develop a complicated and tangled relationship, leading to life-altering consequences.

Entries.Title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
Entries.Description: Mila struggles as she remains unpaid at work and finds comfort in a love interest through his constant phone calls.

Entries.Title: Nothing Like Paris
Entries.Description: Jojo, a Filipino artist in Paris who has had many lovers, but constantly finds himself desperate to fill the chasm in his life occupied by the mysterious muse of his paintings. For years, his heart is held captive by a woman with no name and no history. Like a compass, Jojo looks for her in every girl he meets, hoping she will be “the one.” One day, a woman named Marie, walks up to Jojo and claims to be the subject of his paintings.

Entries.Title: La Querida
Entries.Description: A young couple's romance is cut short when the man learns that his woman is married. Meanwhile, an unhappily married husband meets a lonely teacher and they share an illicit affair.

Entries.Title: Manyak
Entries.Description: Desire and her boyfriend, Adam, stay at her sister's house while they are on vacation. Things turn chaotic when a mysterious man intrudes the house and rapes her.

Entries.Title: Kahalili
Entries.Description: A young woman finds work on a wealthy couple’s farm, but is asked to provide the ultimate service: to serve as a surrogate mother. As her pregnancy progresses, the husband’s growing sexual attachment intensifies.

Entries.Title: Sandwich
Entries.Description: A newly wed couple invites a woman for threesome. Unknown to them someone is watching their sexcapade. When the threesome becomes foursome, that's when chaos begins.

Entries.Title: Moro
Entries.Description: A single mother, who had an ominous dream about her husband who passed away before her, tries to reconcile her two sons. With the help of the local community, peace seems to be coming to the family, but soon the entire region becomes embroiled in serious violence due to the unexpected intervention of government forces.

Entries.Title: GomBurZa
Entries.Description: A powerful and moving historical drama that tells the courageous story of three Filipino Catholic priests: Mariano Gomez, José Burgos, and Jacinto Zamora.

Entries.Title: Hugot: The Player
Entries.Description: A basketball player, turns to drug peddling and gambling to earn more. When he realizes his path endangers not just his life but the people he loves, it's already too late.

Entries.Title: Bugaw
Entries.Description: Siblings Dolores and Isaac were known as the town's prostitutes But when a corrupt police officer holds them captive, they are forced to make a young girl named Lydia, the town's newest prostitute.

Entries.Title: Five Breakups and a Romance
Entries.Description: Even if two people are on the opposite sides of the universe, once the connection is made, they're basically one.

Entries.Title: Kabayo
Entries.Description: A story about Laurene who wants to elevate her seven-year relationship with Conrad. When Easton comes inito the picture, she believes she is the perfect addition to their sexual relationship.

Entries.Title: Paupahan
Entries.Description: A struggling model scores a big rent discount on a small apartment. Thanks to the young caretaker who shows interest in him. Unknown to him, someone behind the mirrors is watching his every move.

Entries.Title: The Blind Soldiers
Entries.Description: Set in a rural Mindanao, as the Japanese invasion intensifies, five men from the Teduray tribe of Cotabato enlisted in the United States of Armed Forces in the Far East (USAFFE) during the World War Two. What starts as a noble intention soon turns out to be a nightmare when they realized the magnitude of the war they signed up for, compounding their struggle is the fact that they are illiterates.

Entries.Title: Ganti-Ganti
Entries.Description: Four lives become intertwined because of one goal - to exact revenge. Things turn bloodier and more chaotic when they all realize who the real mastermind is.

Entries.Title: Siglo ng Kalinga
Entries.Description: Three periods interconnect the life experiences and teachings of Anastacia Giron-Tupas while transposing her story into the lives of her contemporary counterparts. Anna Formantes strives to uphold the personal and professional values of Anastacia Giron Tupas, sacrificing her happiness for education, better degrees and experiences, community advocacy, and advancing nursing standards.

Entries.Title: Fall
Entries.Description: A wild and wet erotic drama thriller starring newest sexy actress Manang Medina. A young man named Edmar falls madly in love with Karisma, a barrio lass. Will he still love her if he finds out Karisma's deepest darkest secret?

Entries.Title: Litrato
Entries.Description: Lola Edna bears the challenges of her debilitating dementia, while killing time in a facility for the elderlies. She collects photos from occasional visitors, mostly strangers, in the hope of remembering her long-lost daughter and granddaughter. She's ill-tempered, a bully to the other old people and to her caregivers. Until she meets Angel, a new caregiver who tempers her behavior. Love-hate relationship ensues between them, until Lola Edna snaps to hurt herself. Contemplative transformation follows and she eventually finds a friend in Angel who not only pampers her with utmost care and attention, but also reunites her with the other grannies and caregivers. On her 65th birthday, Angel surprises her with a revelation that changes their relation from being best buddies, to becoming inseparable soulmates and kindred-spirits.

Entries.Title: Pieta
Entries.Description: Pieta follows Isaac who tries to navigate the outside world after spending years in jail for killing his father.

Entries.Title: Call Me Alma
Entries.Description: Alma, Azi Acosta, is a high-end bar girl. She has decided that prostitution is her profession, her life, her means to achieve her dreams and her happiness. She caters to all men who can afford her price. But she favors two men: a rich lawyer and a bank executive whom she calls Tiger Joe and Kabayo respectively. Another regular customer is a student who has professed his undying love for her. Alma's routine life is disturbed when Sheila, Jaclyn Jose, an aging street prostitute, introduces herself to Alma as her mother who sold her to strangers after birth. This meeting will open the door to Alma's past that she has refused to confront. A long-lost ailing mother, the search for a father, and the truths of a painful past will test the values of these two women who have become victims of poverty and men. In the end, Alma and Sheila will make choices that will define them not only as individuals but as women.

Entries.Title: They Are Mine
Entries.Description: Six people living under one roof face problems that could tear them apart. Amidst this turmoil, the women of the household remain steadfast to keep the family together.

Entries.Title: Litsoneras
Entries.Description: Elria finds out her mother Minerva is having an affair with their worker named Jonas. She plans a dark scheme to break their relationship without knowing she’ll be burnt by temptation.

Entries.Title: Your Mother's Son
Entries.Description: Sarah, a middle-aged woman who hustles as the sole breadwinner of her family of two, scrambles to teach online courses and meet her food orders to provide for her delinquent son Emman. One day, Sarah brings home Oliver, one of her students, to give him refuge from his violent father. Oliver's presence will have an unimagined impact on Emman.

Entries.Title: Sayaw sa Araw at Ulan
Entries.Description: A few days before his sacred transformation, Pablo, a neophyte Tikbalang, hasn't fully accepted his fate, alongside a crisis in his own identity; until one magical night changes his perspective on his world and the self.

Entries.Title: Kitty K7
Entries.Description: After her boyfriend breaks up with her, Hana, an underpaid graphic artist, reinvents herself as Kitty K-7, the newest camgirl of the alter world.

Entries.Title: The Missing
Entries.Description: When an alien comes back to take him, a mouthless young man's life twists and turns as his memories untangle.

Entries.Title: Rookie
Entries.Description: An awkward 6-footer teen is forced to learn and play volleyball half-heartedly when the Catholic school she transferred to did not have a basketball team. Everything changes when she meets their star player.

Entries.Title: Ikaw At Ako
Entries.Description: The film presents a tapestry of love stories that transcend time. From the challenges faced by a couple in their sunset years to the struggles of those in their mid-years, and the blossoming of a puppy love at a summer camp, this film explores the enduring power of love. Join us for a rollercoaster of emotions that will make you believe in love's resilience.

Entries.Title: Sex Games
Entries.Description: A rich couple often spices up their sexual relationship by doing their so-called Sex Games. But when they meet a new set of "playmates"- a conservative couple, their game becomes more challenging.

Entries.Title: Essential Truths of the Lake
