Entries.Description: In 1970s Mindanao, a man and his family take arms to defend the people against those who would oppress them.

Entries.Title: Trophy Wife
Entries.Description: A woman falls in love with a man, but is wronged by him and his brother. She then tries to exact revenge on him, his brother and his new lover.

Entries.Title: Somebody To Love
Entries.Description: In a world full of strangers and friends, there’s a story for everyone. Everyone has a secret. Everyone desires somebody. Everyone needs somebody. Everyone just needs… Somebody To Love…

Entries.Title: She's Dating the Gangster
Entries.Description: Seventeen-year-old Athena Dizon unwittingly plays a trick on resident heartthrob and bad boy Kenji de los Reyes. All of a sudden, she finds herself pretending to be his girlfriend to make an ex jealous; however, she falls in love with him.

Entries.Title: Alienasyon
Entries.Description: A retired university professor who refused to leave his home in the campus despite an administrative order for eviction. With his whole life bearing witness to Diliman estate's evolution, he is the only remaining gatekeeper of the histories of his homeland.

Entries.Title: #Y
Entries.Description: "#Y" chronicles the adventures of the members of a generation made universal by social media, internet, sex, drugs and alcohol.

Entries.Title: Norte, The End of History
Entries.Description: An embittered law student commits a brutal double murder; a family man takes the fall and is forced into a harsh prison sentence; a mother and her two children wander the countryside looking for some kind of redemption.

Entries.Title: A Thief, A Kid & A Killer
Entries.Description: In a failed diamond heist, two hopeless thieves hide out in an apartment taking a ten-year-old boy hostage. With a gang of dirty police closing in on them each thief must decide to what lengths he will go to survive--a decision that will change the boy's life forever.

Entries.Title: M. (Mother's Maiden Name)
Entries.Description: Madam Bella (Zsa Zsa Padilla) has pancreatic cancer, stage 4 and it's treatable but not curable. She asks her son Joven (Nico Antonio), who is outwardly detached, to be with her throughout the medication. In the midst of chemotherapy sessions, Joven begins to realize his mother’s behavior and disposition. Aside from being a stern owner of the Monteclaro Law Firm and a strict mother, Bella is a woman of courage, fighting predicaments not just for herself but most especially for her son. As Joven understands his mother’s personality, he finds his own identity. And as they shape individuality, we get a glimpse of the image of the ailing health care system in and outside the hospital.

Entries.Title: Kamkam
Entries.Description: A study on corrupting power of patriarchy, even among the poor, and how it breeds absolute power that corrupts and destroys families, and relationships.

Entries.Title: Bonifacio
Entries.Description: A heartwarming father and son tale, Bonifacio focuses on the life of a 50-year-old single father Jose Bonifacio "Boni" Garcia and his daily battles with illiteracy and discrimination. He is determined to over come this through education even if it means studying in the same elementary school as his son. Through his resilience and creativity, Bonifacio is able to provide a pleasant home to his son and make life more interesting and bearable for both of them and ultimately find his seemingly lost value as a father and as an individual.

Entries.Title: Tukso si Charito 2
Entries.Description: porny flic

Entries.Title: T'yanak
Entries.Description: T’yanak is the story of Julie’s adopted baby who transforms into a monster and terrorizes their quiet town of Putting Bato with a series of brutal murders, including the wife of townsman who gets wrongly imprisoned for T’yanak’s crime.

Entries.Title: Mariquina
Entries.Description: A Marikina shoemaker's daughter coming to terms with her grief in the wake of her father's suicide.

Entries.Title: Lisyun qng Geografia
Entries.Description: Before leaving Pampanga for good, Tib Apostol finds himself looking for his best friend Tric Torres back in high school. Guided by a map his best friend made for him, Tib attempts to visit each place around his hometown to retrace memories of his friendship with Tric.

Entries.Title: The Trial
Entries.Description: A mentally-challenged guy was put into trial after allegedly raping his teacher. And as Amanda, Julian, and Ronald try to mount a convincing defense, they discover soon that they're all connected in more ways than just the case.

Entries.Title: When I Fall in Love
Entries.Description: A story about Fely and Armando, a year before their 40th wedding anniversary, Armando, a doctor, is diagnosed with Stage 4 pancreatic cancer. Resigned to the fact that his chances of recovery are slim, he chooses to spend the little time he has left with Fely and his three children: Ricky, Nica, and Louie.

Entries.Title: Hindi Sila Tatanda
Entries.Description: A group of friends, prompted by the frequent sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects or U.F.O.'s in Zambales in the mid-nineties, decide to take a trip to the province to retrace the legend of the sightings. They then befriend a local, who they presume is their age group, not knowing exactly who or what he is. Little do they know that the local will become the spark that would threaten to ruin the friendship that has already been strained with many things that have been left unsaid.

Entries.Title: From What Is Before
Entries.Description: The Philippines, 1972. Mysterious things are happening in a remote barrio. Wails are heard from the forest, cows are hacked to death, a man is found bleeding to death at the crossroad and houses are burned. Ferdinand E. Marcos announces Proclamation No. 1081 putting the entire country under Martial Law.

Entries.Title: The Amazing Praybeyt Benjamin
Entries.Description: A soldier who once saved the entire country is assigned to guard a genius child whose intellect is needed to foil the plans of an evil villain.

Entries.Title: Kubot: The Aswang Chronicles 2
Entries.Description: A family of bloodthirsty monsters descends on the city to take revenge on the man that caused the death of so many of their own.

Entries.Title: Children's Show
Entries.Description: A film based on a real life story of children ages 10-15 years old being used by a syndicate for underground wrestling.

Entries.Title: Lamat
Entries.Description: Complicated relationship between a straight couple and a gay boy.

Entries.Title: Asintado
Entries.Description: In the middle of the preparation for the Taong Putik Festival, a young man, penniless and in love, takes on a job that goes terribly wrong. To save him, his mother now makes the most difficult decision of her life.

Entries.Title: Seoul Mates
Entries.Description: Alice is a thirty year old Filipino trans woman who flew to Korea to chase after her boyfriend who she discovers is now living with his new girlfriend. Joon is a twenty five year old Korean musician who is being pressured by his traditional parents to find a more stable job and girlfriend. At a bridge in the middle of Seoul, the two brokenhearted souls fatedly cross paths.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Warat
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Damong Ligaw
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Harot
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Housemates
Entries.Description: Director: G.A. Villafuerte  Writer: G.A. Villafuerte  Stars: Ace Toledo, Gary Guarino, Jigz Imperial, Alvin Victor, Zyrus Miguel, Kael Reyes  Wilber Burdeos, William Jon, Ahvie Cojuangco, Marco Ronquillo, Sean Lim, Francis Cariaso

Entries.Title: DOTA: Nakakabaliw
Entries.Description: An obsession with an online video game turns dangerous for a group of teenagers.

Entries.Title: Aftershock
Entries.Description: Tom's life is crumbling after his lover broke up with him, after losing his job he attempted to kill himself several times but is always foiled by a series of natural and supernatural forces. He eventually realized that there is more to life than love.

Entries.Title: U.S.F.A.
Entries.Description: After almost a decade of waiting, Buboy's US immigration is finally about to be approved. Excitement has been causing his spirit to fly out of his body every night and travel to Disneyland.

Entries.Title: Bloodshot Reverie
Entries.Description: Over a shared cup of coffee with an old friend, Ann revisits revisits her chaotic and passionate Mass Communication student days through bloodshot reveries, ultimately finding solace and reflection in a shared memory at the beach.

Entries.Title: Querido
Entries.Description: A fictionalized account in six chapters of the life of electric Filipino singer-actress Mystica.

Entries.Title: Sonata Maria
Entries.Description: Sonata Maria is a film about a young man who has tremendous difficulty expressing his deepest emotions and has created an alternate reality within which he is able to vent out all his frustrations. It is a moving story of loss, madness and redemption.

Entries.Title: In the Name of Ultimate Warrior
Entries.Description: Seven-year-old Jolo is a fanboy of wrestling icon Ultimate Warrior. When rumors started to spread that the champion wrestler died from a match, the kid's world started to collapse.

Entries.Title: Luhod sa Harapan
Entries.Description: Carlo, an irascible taxi driver, is having a bad day. His sister Nicole carries a torch for him. One night, from a deep slumber, he finds her lying beside him. This gets him livid beyond belief. To make matters worse, gay housemate Rolly is likewise pining for his affection. And he's losing his patience fast.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Magtiwala Ka: A Yolanda Story
Entries.Description: A family struggles to rebuild and restore normalcy in their lives after a super typhoon washes away everything.

Entries.Title: Papa Jesus
Entries.Description: PAPA JESUS is a heart-warming story of a robber trying to steal food from the pantry of a small family and his transformation as he encounters a young boy that mistakes him for someone else.

Entries.Title: Last Trip to Paradise
Entries.Description: A road film about living positively.

Entries.Title: Shunned
Entries.Description: A documentary about the trauma and struggles faced by a group of trans women in the Philippines as they compete in a pageant and find strength in their convictions and one other.

Entries.Title: Aunt Bening
Entries.Description: Left by her daughter to a caregiver, an old lady with Alzheimer's disease suffers as her bedroom burns during the night.

Entries.Title: Black Bird
Entries.Description: As Jimmy Keene begins a 10-year prison sentence, he gets an incredible offer: If he can elicit a confession from suspected killer Larry Hall, Jimmy will be freed. Completing this mission becomes the challenge of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Jimmy Keene is living in the fast lane—until he gets a 10-year prison sentence. Behind bars, he's approached about a high-stakes deal for freedom.

Episodes.Title: We Are Coming, Father Abraham
Episodes.Description: Agent McCauley prepares Jimmy for the mission. Detective Miller questions Larry about the missing women, leading to a polygraph test.

Episodes.Title: Hand to Mouth
Episodes.Description: Struggling with his transition to maximum security prison, Jimmy initiates a friendship with Larry. New holes in Larry's stories are uncovered.

Episodes.Title: WhatsHerName
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of a prison riot, Jimmy and Larry find themselves with time to learn more about each other.

Episodes.Title: The Place I Lie
Episodes.Description: Jimmy's mounting fear and paranoia compel him to provoke Larry. McCauley and Miller have a breakthrough. Larry's therapist grows concerned.

Episodes.Title: You Promised
Episodes.Description: Jimmy reaches his breaking point. Larry becomes suspicious. McCauley and Miller talk to an important person in Larry's life.
